turns.text: what are different fetch modes which are available?

must_contain: MOBILE_OTP authenticates using the user's registered mobile number
AADHAAR_OTP authenticates using the mobile number registered against Aadhaar
DEMOGRAPHICS requires the HIP to send user details exactly as registered with the ABHA number system
DIRECT is a direct means of authenticating with the user
